verdict.rationale: Omnara's GitHub README says organization and project roles can be assigned to API keys, separating access management, agent configuration, operation and view-only access. That is a first-party, role-scoped (least-privilege) credential capability, and the auth docs confirm multiple key types sent as bearer tokens. However, scoping appears to stop at the organization/project role level rather than per individual agent, and detail is thin. Missing for 10: per-agent or per-action key scoping, key expiry/rotation/revocation documentation, in-depth first-party docs on key roles, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Assign organization and project roles to users and API keys. Separate who can manage access, configure agents, operate them, or only view them.
Send either key as a bearer token.
